description: Local coder models for NJ live benchmarks. Default cap is max_size_gb≈9 (Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B footprint) — anything larger in memory is too slow for routine tests.

models.title: Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B
models.notes: NJ historical specialist default; strong tool loops; defines the ~9 GB speed ceiling

models.title: Codestral 22B
models.notes: Mistral code model; above default ≤9 GB roster (use --allow-large-models)

models.title: Devstral 24B
models.notes: Mistral dev/agent model; above default ≤9 GB roster (use --allow-large-models)

models.title: Qwen 3.5 9B
models.notes: Fast modern baseline; also used as NJ utility/tool tier

models.title: Ornith 1.0 9B
models.notes: DeepReinforce agentic coding model; reasoning + tool-calling (GGUF via HF)

models.title: 1-bit Bonsai 27B
models.notes: PrismML 1-bit Q1_0 multimodal 27B (Qwen3.6); ~3.5 GB in memory. Pull via hf.co (Q1_0). Needs Ollama with Q1_0 support.

models.title: Ternary Bonsai 27B
models.notes: PrismML ternary Q2_0 ~7.2 GB. Stock ollama pull rejects :Q2_0 — download GGUF + ollama create (scripts/import-hf-gguf-models.py).

models.title: CodeGemma 7B
models.notes: Google code-focused instruct model; fill-in-middle and codegen

models.title: Gemma 3 12B
models.notes: Google Gemma 3 mid-tier; good general + code balance
